question: Which of the following countries became the first to launch the malaria vaccine RTS,S?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malawi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Malaria vaccine**

 
 
• The world's first malaria vaccine was launched in Malawi, a small country located in Southeast Africa 
 
• It was an initiative of WHO (World Health Organization) which is a coordinated program between three countries Kenya, Ghana and Malawi
 
• The vaccine will give the children partial protection against the deadly disease that plagues the region
 
• The vaccine will be launched in the remaining two countries in the coming weeks
